title: Can Rabbits Eat Blueberries?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Blueberries?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage, bedding guide and hay guide.
- Replace the image URLs below with your blueberry images once uploaded.
-->

<section class="rcb-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-blueberries">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcb-page,
    .rcb-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcb-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcb-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    .rcb-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcb-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rcb-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rcb-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcb-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rcb-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcb-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcb-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rcb-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcb-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcb-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcb-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcb-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rcb-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcb-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcbFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcb-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcb-hero-title-overlay .rcb-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcb-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcb-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcb-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcb-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcb-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rcb-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcb-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcb-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcb-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rcb-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcb-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcb-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcb-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rcb-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcb-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcb-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rcb-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rcb-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rcb-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcb-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }

    .rcb-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcb-section h2,
    .rcb-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcb-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rcb-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcb-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rcb-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcb-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcb-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rcb-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }

    .rcb-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcb-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rcb-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rcb-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcb-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcb-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcb-treat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcb-treat-card {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcb-treat-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcb-treat-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .rcb-treat-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.22rem; }
    .rcb-treat-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcb-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcb-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcb-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rcb-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rcb-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcb-warning-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcb-warning-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rcb-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rcb-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }

    .rcb-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rcb-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }

    .rcb-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rcb-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
      object-fit: contain !important;
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rcb-prep {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcb-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcb-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcb-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcb-step h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rcb-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcb-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rcb-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcb-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcb-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcb-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcb-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcb-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcb-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rcb-benefits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rcb-benefit {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcb-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rcb-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcb-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }

    .rcb-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-blueberry-4.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcb-final-box .rcb-pill,
    .rcb-final-box h2,
    .rcb-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcb-final-box p {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rcb-final-box .rcb-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }


    .rcb-faq {
      padding: 72px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.07), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcb-faq .rcb-panel { overflow: visible; }

    .rcb-faq .rcb-section-header { margin-bottom: 28px; }

    .rcb-faq-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rcb-faq-item {
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: background 0.22s ease, border-color 0.22s ease;
    }

    .rcb-faq-item[open] {
      background: #ffffff;
      border-color: rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.18);
    }

    .rcb-faq-item summary {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      line-height: 1.25;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcb-faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }

    .rcb-faq-item summary::after {
      content: "+";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-brown);
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      line-height: 1;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcb-faq-item[open] summary::after { content: "–"; }

    .rcb-faq-item p {

          </article>

      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcb-section rcb-reveal" id="benefits">
      <div class="rcb-wrap">
        <div class="rcb-section-header">
          <span class="rcb-pill">Treat benefits</span>
          <h2>Benefits and signs your rabbit enjoys blueberries</h2>
          <p>
            When given in moderation, blueberries can add variety and make treat time enjoyable. Even if your rabbit loves them, fruit should always be limited.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcb-benefits-grid">
          <article class="rcb-benefit">
            <h3>Adds variety</h3>
            <p>A blueberry can add occasional variety to a hay-based diet.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcb-benefit">
            <h3>Small amounts of nutrients</h3>
            <p>Blueberries contain some vitamins and antioxidants, but they should not replace leafy greens or hay.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcb-benefit">
            <h3>Easy to portion</h3>
            <p>Their small size makes blueberries easier to portion than many larger fruits.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcb-benefit">
            <h3>Bonding treat</h3>
            <p>Many rabbits eagerly take blueberry, making it useful for positive, gentle interaction.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcb-benefit">
            <h3>Signs they enjoy it</h3>
            <p>Your rabbit may run over quickly, sniff eagerly, chew enthusiastically or search for more.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcb-benefit">
            <h3>Still limit treats</h3>
            <p>Even enthusiastic rabbits should only have blueberries occasionally to keep their diet balanced.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <section class="rcb-faq rcb-reveal" id="faqs" aria-label="Blueberry rabbit FAQs">
      <div class="rcb-narrow">
        <div class="rcb-panel">
          <div class="rcb-section-header">
            <span class="rcb-pill">FAQs</span>
            <h2>Rabbit blueberry FAQs</h2>
            <p>Quick answers to common questions about feeding blueberries to rabbits safely.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="rcb-faq-list">
            <details class="rcb-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat blueberries safely?</summary>
              <p>Yes, most healthy rabbits can eat blueberries safely in very small amounts. Blueberries should be treated as an occasional fruit treat, not a daily food.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcb-faq-item">
              <summary>How many blueberries can rabbits eat?</summary>
              <p>A sensible guide is one or two blueberries once or twice per week, depending on your rabbit’s size, health and usual diet. Introduce them slowly and watch for changes in poo or appetite.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcb-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat blueberry skin?</summary>
              <p>Yes, rabbits can eat the skin of fresh blueberries. Wash the berries thoroughly first to remove dirt or residue.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcb-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat dried blueberries?</summary>
              <p>Dried blueberries are not recommended because dried fruit is much more concentrated in sugar than fresh fruit. Fresh blueberries in tiny portions are a better choice.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rcb-faq-item">
              <summary>Can baby rabbits eat blueberries?</summary>
              <p>Baby rabbits should not be given sugary fruit treats. Young rabbits need a carefully managed diet, and new foods should be introduced cautiously once they are old enough. Ask a rabbit-savvy vet if unsure.</p>
            </details>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcb-final rcb-reveal">
      <div class="rcb-wrap rcb-final-box">
        <span class="rcb-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Blueberries can be a safe occasional treat for rabbits</h2>
        <p>
          Rabbits can eat blueberries in small amounts, and many rabbits enjoy their sweet taste. However, blueberries are still fruit, so they should only be offered occasionally.
        </p>
        <p>
          Keep portions tiny, avoid dried or processed blueberry foods, and watch your rabbit’s digestion when introducing anything new. A rabbit’s diet should still be based mainly on hay, with fresh vegetables and leafy greens forming the rest of their daily food.
        </p>
